$comment: The 5 core testing criteria from the Definition of Done. Each is applied to all 13 conditions, producing 65 test cases and 65 verifiable result artifacts. run_mode determines how the harness invokes Claude Code; assertions are evaluated by evaluate.py against the captured artifacts.

criteria.title: Eval loop with full success-criteria mapping
criteria.intent: Every requirement of the condition is mapped to a scored, individually-attributable criterion. A pass requires 100% of mapped criteria met, so partial credit cannot masquerade as success.

criteria.title: Validation testing
criteria.intent: The skill actually does what the condition states against a seeded defect with a known correct answer. Functional correctness, not self-report.

criteria.title: Regression testing
criteria.intent: The condition is re-satisfied on a second independent run, and every defect previously recorded as fixed in the regression ledger stays fixed. Catches both nondeterministic collapse and reintroduction of known defects.

criteria.title: End-to-end automation script
criteria.intent: The whole condition is exercised non-interactively by a script with no human in the loop: locked-down permission mode, bounded turns, machine-readable result, zero-versus-nonzero exit branching.

criteria.title: Sandboxed deployment
criteria.intent: The condition is satisfied entirely inside the sandbox: nothing outside the sandbox root is created, modified or deleted, and no tool outside the declared allowlist is invoked.
